title: feat(studio): a collapsible left menu of six groups replaces the top pillar nav
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBTuMGhLAZx29zwDrayDGZZF)_
Fixes #36899
Part of #36890
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziBCAytAzzCu3iPBFR

## 维护者速读

- 建应用的人在 Studio 里，顶部那排“数据/自动化/访问/全部元数据”切换没了，换成左侧一列可折叠菜单：数据、界面、自动化、平台、访问、AI 六组，每组带数量和搜索，折叠后刷新还记得，手机上是抽屉。
- 属于“Studio 重构”这条主线（左侧菜单是后面列表页、全屏详情和设计器改造的落脚点）。
- 出问题时作者可能找不到某类元数据的入口，或折叠状态不记忆；不动任何数据，直接撤回这次改动就回到顶部切换。
- 无。

## What changes

**Studio's one navigation is now a left menu of six groups** (amended ADR-0084: Data, UI, Automation, Platform, Access, AI; zh 数据、界面、自动化、平台、访问、AI). The top pillar switcher is gone from every Studio page.

- **What it lists.** Each group lists the metadata types the open package holds, by the type directory's own rule: `scopeDirectoryEntries` (new `directoryScope.ts`) is now read by both `DirectoryPage` and the menu, so the two never disagree. A group carries its type count, an entry its item count (the diagnostics sweep the directory already reads), and a search box narrows entries by label or machine name. Object, Flow and Permission Set are always listed, so an empty package can create its first one.
- **Where entries go.** A type entry opens that type's list in the area (`/studio/PKG/metadata/TYPE?package=PKG`); an item of an object, flow or permission set still opens its designer through `areaItemPillarPath`, so the pillar routes stay and are reached as before. Four entries are not a type: **Organization flows** (`/studio/~org/automations`) under Automation, **Default sharing** (the Access pillar on `?surface=owd:overview`; the page itself is #36905's) under Access, **Diagnostics** (`metadata/_diagnostics`) under Platform, and **Positions and permissions** (the environment catalog on `~all`) under Access. Datasource still goes to Setup (ADR-0146 D1).
- **Current entry.** The open page's entry carries `aria-current="page"` and the sidebar's active state: an area page marks its type, a pillar marks the type it designs (Data marks Object, Automations marks Flow, Access marks Permission Set, Access on the OWD overview marks Default sharing).
- **Collapse.** It is the app sidebar's own primitive (`SidebarProvider` / `Sidebar collapsible="offcanvas"` from `@object-ui/components`), docked below the top bar. The top bar's leading toggle hides and shows it; the state survives a reload under **Studio's own cookie `studio_menu_state`**, never the app sidebar's `sidebar_state`. Below 768 px it is a drawer that closes when an entry is chosen. `SidebarProvider` gains an optional `cookieName` prop for this (default unchanged), declared as a new shadcn local-patch family in `ui/scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs` with its pin.
- **Group names (binding note 7127465963).** I changed the two dictionary labels rather than mapping in the menu: `translateMetadataDomain('system')` is now Platform / 平台 and `security` is Access / 访问. Every reader of the dictionary is now a Studio surface (Setup's metadata routes redirect into the Studio area), so the menu and the area's headers read the same names.
- **`~all` frame: merged into one shell.** `/studio/~all/metadata/*` is now served by the same route as a package's area (`:packageId/metadata/*` already outranked `~all/*`), and `StudioDesignSurface` draws it with no package, no package actions and no right slot, beside the same menu. The landing's frame (`StudioConsoleFrame`) now frames only the landing. `areaLocationRedirect` now sends a `~org` area URL, or `?package=~org`, to the package-less flows instead of reading `~org` as a package.
- **「‹ Back to app」 (decision 5 + maintainer ruling 7127681255).** It names the current package's app, never a remembered app of another package; a recorded page of one of the package's own apps is still where it returns. A package with no app, and the org-level and cross-package entries, name the package (or the scope: Organization flows / Positions and permissions) and go to the apps home.
- **变更 / 发布 stay where they are:** at the right end of the top bar, beside Cancel and Save, drawn while drafts are pending (objectstack#36511).
- Kept: the save coordinator, the unsaved-work guard (a menu link that leaves asks once through the shell's link guard; the Default sharing entry, which re-enters the open Access pillar on another query, asks through the surface's own confirm and then remounts the pillar once the router holds the new query), the right slot and copilot dock, the changes panel and Publish, the writable gate and paired package, and the package-missing empty state (no menu there).
- en and zh strings: `engine.studio.pillar.*` removed, `engine.studio.menu.*` added.

### Choices the card asked to state

| Question | Choice |
| --- | --- |
| Group names | Changed the two dictionary labels (system = Platform/平台, security = Access/访问) |
| `~all` frame | Merged into the builder's shell: one shell, one menu on every Studio page |
| Cookie key | `studio_menu_state` (own key; `sidebar_state` untouched) |
| 变更 / 发布 | Stay at the top bar's right end beside Cancel / Save |
| Address builder (#36895, PR #36973) | Not landed when this opened: menu links are built the existing way (`studioMetadataAreaPath`, `studioPillarItemPath`, `studioOrgScopePath`), and #36895 folds them into `studioAddress` whichever lands second. No `STUDIO_ITEM_PILLAR` row and no scope-segment encoding is changed here. |

### Where the work landed outside the stated file surface

- `ui/packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx` and `ui/scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs` (the surface said "read; a new cookie key"): the provider hard-coded `sidebar_state` on every write, ⌘B included, so a second key needed the `cookieName` prop. It is a declared local patch with its pin.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/DirectoryPage.tsx` and new `directoryScope.ts`: the directory's listing rule moved into one helper the menu shares (item 1 says the menu reuses the directory's grouping data).
- The apps home: the console has no `/apps` index route, so "back to the apps home" goes to `useHomePath()` (the `/home` launcher in Studio), which is what the console calls the apps home.
- The menu's group labels carry `HIDDEN_ICON_LABEL_NOT_FOCUSABLE`, as every `SidebarGroupLabel` call site does (objectui#12795 call-site pin); the menu is offcanvas, so the classes never take effect there.

### Known regression (temporary, accepted by the seat 2026-11-24 13:41Z)

- **⌘K on `~all`:** `~all` now renders inside Studio's builder shell, so the console `AppHeader` and its ⌘K command palette are no longer drawn on the `~all` leg. Studio's own ⌘K arrives with #36900, which is queued next on the list side once this PR and #36895 land.

## Tests

- New: `studioMenuModel.test.ts` (groups, entries, links, counts, current-entry rule, search), `StudioMenu.test.tsx` (own cookie and remount, app sidebar collapse does not collapse the menu, drawer below 768 px closing on choose, aria-current, counts, search with no-match status, focus order toggle then search then entries), a sidebar `cookieName` case in `sidebar-cookie-restore.test.tsx`, the patch-family pin in `shadcn-local-patches.test.ts`, a `~org` case in `metadataArea.test.ts`, console route cases (`~all` on the builder route, the entry gate before `~org/automations`, the OWD overview and Diagnostics, no recent-package record for `~all`).
- The eight surface tests that asserted `studio-pillar-nav` now assert the menu: `notFound-26708`, `accessSegment-12452`, `heldDataLeave-26705`, `heldFlowLeave-26705`, `interfacesRetired-36502`, `metadataArea-28561`, `pillarNavGuard`, `narrowHeader-12509`; `backToApp-36501` and `packageLessFlows-11553` follow decision 5. Also converted: `packageListErrorPosture` (the menu and its toggle survive a package-list failure), `homeLoop-12513` (the menu toggle is the bar's first button, Back to app the first way out after it) and `heldFlowLeave-26705` (module-top `@objectstack/lint` import, as its held-data sibling has).
- E2E: `ui/e2e/studio-left-menu-36899.spec.ts`, a Chromium page bundling the real menu: docked at the left with the content beside it, off the canvas when collapsed with the content at full width, still collapsed after a reload (cookie on a real http origin), a drawer inside the viewport at 390 px.

<details><summary>Local readings at 214400bd3, patch rounds to 1f7534d18</summary>

- `vitest run` on the 50 touched and related files (touched tests, every test naming `translateMetadataDomain` or a `security`/`system` domain, DirectoryPage, StudioRoute, StudioBackToApp, packageLess, sidebar): `Test Files 50 passed (50)`, `Tests 450 passed (450)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: `Test Files 172 passed | 2 skipped (174)`, `Tests 5130 passed | 2 skipped`, `VERDICT command-exit 0` (at b9018320e; the last commit touched only the e2e spec).
- `type-check` of `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console` and `type-check:e2e`: `VERDICT command-exit 0` (at b9018320e; `type-check:e2e` re-run at 214400bd3).
- `playwright test e2e/studio-left-menu-36899.spec.ts --project chromium`: `3 passed`.
- Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): all 18 exit 0 locally; `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check-nul-bytes`, `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` exit 0.
- Patch round at df57661bb (CI red at 214400bd3 on "Test-source alias gate"): `heldFlowLeave-26705` now imports `@objectstack/lint` at module top, as its held-data sibling does. `node scripts/check-test-source-alias.mjs` exit 1 before, exit 0 after (`123 packages with tests scanned`); `--self-test` exit 0.
- Patch round at 1f7534d18 (CI red at df57661bb on Test UI 3/16, 4/16, 14/16): the three files at the pre-fix versions `Test Files 3 failed (3)`, `Tests 3 failed | 10 passed (13)`, `VERDICT command-exit 1`; on the fix `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 13 passed (13)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Screenshots below are the real console (`ui/apps/console` dev server, this branch) against a running server: a self-built app (created through the Studio landing's New app, `com.default.field-service`) on the showcase example server, and HotCRM (its own repo at main, `app.objectstack.hotcrm`) on its published 18.6.0 server. On HotCRM the Data pillar's rail shows "Couldn't read customizations": that is this branch's console against an older published server, not the menu.
- Readings from the same runs: no `studio-pillar-nav` on the page; six groups in order; the Object entry current on the Data pillar; after collapse `data-state=collapsed`, the cookie `studio_menu_state=false` and no `sidebar_state`, still collapsed after a reload; at 390 px no docked menu until the toggle, then a 288 px drawer at the left edge.
- Overlap check (`overlap-check.mjs`, final head): merges cleanly with main; textual conflicts with #36973, #36958 and #36784 in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (and `metadataArea.ts` with #36973), all in the header region this card replaces. Their code is not reshaped here.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: the header and body row (menu mounted inside the provider), the `~all` branch, and the re-entry remount (`reenterPillar` plus its layout effect).
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioMenuModel.ts`: what each scope lists and where each entry goes; `studioMenuCurrentKey`.
3. `ui/packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx` with `ui/scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs`: the `cookieName` prop and its declared patch.

Two-minute check: open `/studio/PKG/data` for any package, click the toggle at the top-left, reload. Expected: the left menu stays hidden after the reload, and the app sidebar elsewhere in the console keeps its own state.
